The large engine mismatch is not treated as fixture noise: snapshots and AX/HTML evidence support the Salesforce/lightning shadow-DOM carousel, product-selection, sticky-footer, live-status, and consent-dialog traversal. Keep as candidate evidence rather than an exact gate until reusable dynamic-state/shadow-DOM behavior is refined.
